$comment: Kiosk background legibility test vectors, version 3: per-cell min/max bounds, a light dim for controls, a plate per text (solid over texture). Shared by the console (web/src/data/kioskScrim.test.ts) and the agent. Rules: docs/kiosk-background-scrim.md. image.cells are [min, max] per cell, row-major; element boxes are dp in the window; elements with the same row are the labels of one grid row (version 3.1: they share the row's highest plate step). Colours by kind: text = palette text, secondary = palette secondary, control = palette text (the outlined Exit button's 1 dp border; it gets no plate, its step is always 0). ratio values rounded to 2 decimals (compare within 0.01). Version 3.3 adds labelLines: how an app label breaks into lines (at word boundaries only), from per-character widths, so the cases are font-independent.

layout.name: calm-dark
layout.note: dark image: no dim, no plates

layout.name: white-sheet
layout.note: white image: dim capped at 15, text on plates

layout.name: no-controls
layout.note: without an Exit button nothing is dimmed

layout.name: mid-grey-exit
layout.note: mid grey: a light dim brings the Exit button to 3:1

layout.name: texture-solid
layout.note: texture under the label (a channel spans more than 48 levels): a solid plate

layout.name: texture-dark-enough
layout.note: texture that is dark enough everywhere: no plate even though busy

layout.name: smooth-bright
layout.note: smooth bright area (span 30 levels): a translucent plate

layout.name: band-under-label
layout.note: only the label sits on a bright band: only it gets a plate

layout.name: margin-cell
layout.note: a bright cell just outside the box counts (1-cell margin): texture, so a solid plate

layout.name: beyond-margin
layout.note: a bright cell two cells away does not count

layout.name: secondary-text
layout.note: secondary text needs a stronger plate than primary

layout.name: light-kiosk
layout.note: light kiosk colours over a dark photo

layout.name: saturated
layout.note: saturated colours: per-channel bounds

layout.name: cropped-portrait
layout.note: a landscape image in a portrait window: only the centre counts

layout.name: row-one-needs-a-plate
layout.note: one label of the row needs a plate: the whole row gets its step

layout.name: row-texture-one-label
layout.note: one label of the row is over texture (solid): the whole row is solid

layout.name: row-none-needs-a-plate
layout.note: no label of the row needs a plate: none gets one

layout.name: two-rows
layout.note: rows are independent: a plate in one row does not reach the other

layout.name: teal-sunset
layout.note: brand colours

layout.name: busy-span-48
layout.note: a channel spans exactly 48 levels: not busy

layout.name: busy-span-49
layout.note: a channel spans 49 levels: busy, solid plate

layout.name: cells-of-3-px
layout.note: 117 x 253 px image (cells of 3 px) in 360 x 780 dp: non-terminating scale, edges inside cells

layout.name: alpha-pixels
layout.note: transparent and half-transparent white pixels over a teal background

layout.name: fit-letterbox
layout.note: fit: a wide image in a tall window, a label in the letterbox and one on the image

layout.name: fit-ignores-focal
layout.note: fit: the focal point changes nothing

layout.name: focal-left
layout.note: fill, focal at the left edge: the bright part is under the label

layout.name: focal-right
layout.note: fill, focal at the right edge: the bright part is cropped away

layout.name: right-edge-ceil
layout.note: a bright cell just past a right edge inside a cell: ceil, then the margin

layout.name: busy-after-dim
layout.note: texture under the label is busy undimmed but not once dimmed: a translucent plate

layout.name: two-controls-one-weak
layout.note: two controls, one over a dark area and one over a bright one: the dim serves both

layout.name: letterbox-on-clipped-box
layout.note: fit with the image filling the window: a box past the window edge has no letterbox

layout.name: edge-on-cell-boundary
layout.note: a box edge on a cell boundary (x0 = (x - rx) / scale, doubles, in that order)

layout.name: edge-a-hair-below-a-boundary
layout.note: x0 a hair below 30 px: floor without rounding first (cell 9, margin cell 8)

labelLines.name: single-long-word
labelLines.note: one word wider than the box: ellipsized on its line, never broken

labelLines.name: long-word-then-short
labelLines.note: an over-wide first word takes its own (ellipsized) line; the next word starts line 2

labelLines.name: three-words-overflow
labelLines.note: line 1 greedy, line 2 is the rest, ellipsized

labelLines.name: hyphen
labelLines.note: breaks after a hyphen, the hyphen stays on line 1

labelLines.name: trailing-hyphen-word
labelLines.note: a hyphen at the end of a word is no extra break

labelLines.name: cjk
labelLines.note: no spaces: CJK characters break between any two

labelLines.name: cjk-mixed
labelLines.note: Latin word, space, then CJK characters

labelLines.name: no-space-latin
labelLines.note: a run without spaces in a spaced script is one word: ellipsized, never broken

labelLines.name: rtl
labelLines.note: right to left: the same rule on the logical order; the platform shows it mirrored

labelLines.name: three-lines-at-large-font
labelLines.note: maxLines 3 (the agent at a font scale above 1)

labelLines.name: over-long-label
